Requirement (Summary): Study and plan CRM marketing strategy via LINE OA @MRTA + Loyalty Program for MRTA target groups (transit users / building-parking users / real-estate tenants / future customers)
Platform Support: AMP Workflows + AMP AI Decisioning + Loyalty
Quick Notes: AMP (Automation + Marketing + Personalization) handles journey/segmentation/triggered campaigns; Loyalty Program provides the earn-burn engine; strategy study itself is a service deliverable not a platform feature.

Requirement (Summary): Strategy to retain followers with Block Rate <=20% of total followers
Quick Notes: Platform tracks block/unblock events and broadcast performance; the <=20% target is an operational KPI not a feature flag. Rocket's CS/Marketing team would deliver the retention strategy.

Requirement (Summary): Design earn/burn mechanics: point earning rules / redemption / reward exchange suitable to target customers and partner network
Quick Notes: Full configurable point currency (earn rules / expiry / windows) + reward catalog with tier/persona/tag pricing matrix + reward groups for bundled redemption. Design consultation is a Rocket service.

Requirement (Summary): Analyze and allocate reward value budget across contract period
Quick Notes: Reward coin pricing configurable per reward/tier; budget allocation modeling is a Reward Strategy team service.

Requirement (Summary): Procure/create rewards and privileges sufficient for contract duration
Quick Notes: Partner catalog (pay-on-redeem digital + physical) + merchant-owned privileges. Rocket's Reward Strategy team curates and onboards partners.

Requirement (Summary): Renew LINE OA account and message packages (incl. additional messages); >=20M messages over contract
Support Level: Out of the box (integration) / Pass-through cost
Quick Notes: Platform integrates any LINE OA via channel token/secret. The OA subscription + 20M message package is a LINE-billed cost passed through to MRTA; budget line-item not a feature.

Requirement (Summary): Update TH/EN content; plan and send Broadcast messages to target segments
Quick Notes: AMP supports segment-targeted broadcast/triggered messaging; Translation System covers TH/EN dynamic + static UI text. Broadcast quota governed by LINE Messaging API tier.

Requirement (Summary): Configure chatbot with keyword triggers (point balance / rewards etc.) for instant auto-response; subject to MRTA approval
Quick Notes: Native: keyword triggers (case-insensitive + synonym lists) / button menus / decision trees / "talk to human" breakout / per-channel on/off. Deflection-to-knowledge-base supported.

Requirement (Summary): Develop and improve display format and features suitable to target groups
Quick Notes: Admin Shell + member-facing loyalty web app are configurable and continuously improved by Rocket. Custom display tweaks are professional services.

Requirement (Summary): Manage sessions and ensure accurate point calculation across LINE OA + Loyalty Program
Quick Notes: Channel session_timeout/threading defaults (LINE 24h/48h) + wallet ledger is single source of truth for points; accuracy is platform-enforced.

Requirement (Summary): Design Rich Menu shortcuts (>=3 formats) with buttons to sections (tickets / promo / map / parking / contact / MRTA Rewards)
Quick Notes: Rich Menu is a LINE-native asset; our chatbot flows bind Rich Menu taps to flows/sections. Design of the Rich Menu image itself is a creative service.

Requirement (Summary): Design Card Message / carousel slides for promo/event browsing
Quick Notes: LINE Template Messages / Carousel (Carousel Template / Flex Message) supported via outbound adapter; content design is a creative service.

Requirement (Summary): Design >=10 Greeting Messages that pop-up on first Add Friend
Quick Notes: LINE OA Greeting Message API supported; multiple greeting variants configurable. Creative copy/design is a service.

Requirement (Summary): Collect: Full name / LINE ID / Email / Phone / Address (for reward shipping); PDPA-compliant single-source design
Quick Notes: Signup form with default fields (name/email/phone/address) + Custom Fields for any extras; PDPA Consent feature handles consent capture/versioning; LINE UID auto-linked via OAuth.

Requirement (Summary): Display full privilege conditions (earning rules / redemption / usage); support separate OR combined groups (building/parking users vs. campaign participants)
Quick Notes: Reward records expose full T&Cs; Reward Groups bundle/redemption-control; Tags & Personas + Persona Entitlements enable group-specific rules and visibility.

Requirement (Summary): Reward listing with search by code or name; settable categories; pre-launch configuration
Quick Notes: Reward catalog has search (name/code) + categories + active/inactive scheduling; admin-configurable before go-live.

Requirement (Summary): Search by keyword returns same-category rewards/privileges (e.g. search "coffee" returns all cafe rewards)
Support Level: Out of the box (category filter) / Partial (semantic)
Quick Notes: Category-tagged search is native. True semantic "related results" may need configuration of category/synonym mapping; not ML-semantic by default.

Requirement (Summary): Deduct points on redeem; real-time Sold-Out messaging
Quick Notes: Redemption ledger + atomic point deduction via wallet; stock-aware rewards show real-time availability; sold-out messaging configurable.

Requirement (Summary): Show member's redemption history and point age/expiry
Quick Notes: Wallet ledger provides full history; point expiry windows (earn date / validity) configured per currency and surfaced to member.

Requirement (Summary): Generate unique E-Coupon Codes rendered as alphanumeric + Barcode + QR Code for non-shipped rewards
Support Level: Out of the box (code generation) / Partial (rendering)
Quick Notes: reward_promo_code table generates unique codes natively. Barcode/QR Code visual rendering may require FE integration or a rendering service (e.g. barcode/QR library on the member app); logic is supported.

Requirement (Summary): Track physical reward status and provide parcel/tracking number to customer for self-tracking
Quick Notes: Fulfillment partner integration surfaces tracking number on physical rewards; member sees delivery status. Specific courier integrations may need partner connector.

Requirement (Summary): Satisfaction survey after redemption/activity; collect and analyze satisfaction/expectations
Quick Notes: Native post-event survey with configurable trigger / channel / cooldown / suppression; negative-score routes to QA. Triggers can be configured on redemption events.

Requirement (Summary): Dashboard view of redemption/campaign overview; export to .xlsx/.jpeg/.csv
Quick Notes: Analytics dashboards + tabular export (CSV/XLSX) native. JPEG/image export of charts depends on the charting library; CSV/XLSX is standard.

Requirement (Summary): Grant MRTA officers access to view data and manage listings on Loyalty Program
Quick Notes: Admin Shell supports multi-role admin (officer/super-admin/etc.) with RBAC; MRTA officers can be granted scoped read/manage permissions.

Requirement (Summary): Operate per international security standards; propose authentication etc. subject to MRTA approval
Quick Notes: JWT-based auth (admin/user/superadmin) + RLS at database layer + HMAC webhook validation. Supabase platform provides enterprise-grade security posture.

Requirement (Summary): Provide advice/consulting and system documentation throughout contract
Quick Notes: Not a platform feature; covered by Rocket's CS / Solution Architect service.

Requirement (Summary): Hand over all CRM data (LINE OA + Loyalty) to MRTA at no extra cost at contract end
Quick Notes: All platform data (members/points/redemptions) exportable via SQL/API/CSV. LINE OA follower data and message logs require LINE Messaging API export; subject to LINE's data retention rules.

Requirement (Summary): Not use data outside MRTA purpose; destroy test/other data at contract end with destruction certificate
Quick Notes: PDPA Consent + RLS enforce purpose-bound access. Data destruction + certificate is an operational/compliance deliverable signed off by Rocket.

Requirement (Summary): Maintain LINE OA + Loyalty continuity; fix issues within 1 day of notification
Quick Notes: Platform uptime is managed; 1-day response SLA is a contractual support tier (Standard/Premium) not a feature.

Requirement (Summary): Pen test + hardening; patch vulnerabilities per severity (Critical 30d / High 45d / Medium 60d / Low 120d); ISO/IEC cert acceptable for off-the-shelf software
Support Level: Out of the box (Supabase) / Service (pen test)
Quick Notes: Supabase is ISO 27001 / SOC 2 Type II certified. Pen testing + remediation SLA per severity is a Rocket security service; cert submission is documentation.

Requirement (Summary): Notify and get MRTA approval before entering to fix issues
Quick Notes: Change-management process; not a feature.

Requirement (Summary): Acquire partners for Co-Promotion; manage reward stock per plan
Quick Notes: Partner acquisition + contracting is a Reward Strategy team service (typical onboarding ~5 business days). Stock management is native (reward_stock_store + reorder thresholds).

Requirement (Summary): Accumulate >=60 brands across 3 tiers: Dept Store/Large (1/2/3) / Product & Service (10/20/30) / SME (10/20/30); 15-day listing turnaround
Quick Notes: Brand acquisition is a Rocket Reward Strategy team commitment with partner network; 15-day listing SLA is operational. The platform supports unlimited brands.

Requirement (Summary): Reward details: name / description (text/image/video) / point cost / type (Physical/Non-Physical)
Quick Notes: Reward record has all these fields natively (name/description/media/points/type). Media upload via Supabase Storage.

Requirement (Summary): Ship physical rewards within 15 days of redemption request
Quick Notes: Standard physical fulfillment SLA is 2-5 business days (target); 15-day SLA is comfortably met. Emergency handling requires MRTA notification per TOR.

Requirement (Summary): Manage stock of MRTA services + Premium Gifts; return remaining stock to MRTA on contract end
Quick Notes: Stock tracking + reorder thresholds native. Returns processing is an operational handover at contract end.

Requirement (Summary): Coordinate with gov/private parties for permits and execution; vendor bears costs
Quick Notes: Project management deliverable; not a feature.

Requirement (Summary): Vendor bears all reward tax withholding + fees on behalf of MRTA and winners
Quick Notes: Tax compliance + withholding on reward value is a finance/legal service handled by Rocket; not a feature.

Requirement (Summary): Run >=12 marketing activities covering contract period; short/mid-term plans; >=200 new followers per activity
Quick Notes: Native campaign engines (Missions / Spin Wheel / Mass Lucky Draw / Referral / Check-in) + AMP journey orchestration. Follower-count tracking via LINE OA analytics.

Requirement (Summary): 11 report types: registrations / engagement per activity / new followers / block & open rate / reward fulfillment / messages sent / partners / PR media / redemption & inventory / issue summary / SLA & recovery
Quick Notes: Most metrics (registrations/engagement/followers/block/open/messages/redemption/inventory) available in Analytics. PR media + issue summary + SLA recovery reports require configuration/custom views.

Requirement (Summary): Provide Call Center + Admin (>=1 person) for support; advise on points/status/redemption/shipping; 24/7 or as MRTA agrees
Platform Support: Unified Inbox + Agent Workspace + Rocket BPO
Quick Notes: Unified Inbox / Agent Workspace / Voice Console / Routing & Assignment support full Call Center ops on the platform. Staffing (>=1 FTE 24/7) is a BPO service.

Requirement (Summary): Coordinate CRM activities with other MRTA activities/representatives
Quick Notes: Operational coordination; not a feature.
